description: This file defines the ShapeResult class used for managing display shapes in OrchardCore, including shape creation, placement, display, caching, and rendering logic.

classes.name: ShapeResult
classes.description: Represents a display shape with configuration for placement, display, caching, and rendering within OrchardCore.

methods.name: ApplyAsync
methods.description: Applies the shape rendering logic for display or editor contexts.

methods.name: ApplyImplementationAsync
methods.description: Core method that handles shape placement, initialization, and addition to parent shapes.

methods.name: Prefix
methods.description: Sets the prefix for form elements within the shape.

methods.name: Location
methods.description: Sets default or display-type-specific location for the shape.

methods.name: Displaying
methods.description: Sets a delegate to execute when the shape is displayed.

methods.name: Processing
methods.description: Sets a delegate to execute when the shape is rendered.

methods.name: Differentiator
methods.description: Sets a discriminator for shape placement when multiple shapes of the same type are used.

methods.name: OnGroup
methods.description: Assigns group IDs for shape rendering constraints.

methods.name: RenderWhen
methods.description: Sets a condition for rendering the shape.
